description:
Problem. `.github/workflows/measurement.yml` offers `duckdb-tpch-sf10`, `duckdb-ssb-sf10` and `duckdb-tpcds-sf10`. All three failed on `ubuntu-latest` (16 GB) on 2026-11-18 (runs 44348383365, 44348387772, 44348393835), and the owner dropped DuckDB SF10 evidence on 2026-11-18 (duckdb-tuned-template-ablation-20261008, closed). The cells now invite runs that cannot succeed.
Expected outcome. The workflow and `docs/internal/measurement-workflow.md` offer only cells that can finish, or mark SF10 as needing a larger runner.

## Decision gate
(owner): remove the three cells, or keep them documented as needing a larger runner class (named) for a future decision. Recommendation: remove; re-adding is a small change.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`, `make agent-write-preflight`); never edit the primary clone.
- No skip, xfail, rerun marker, raised timeout or weakened assertion to turn a check green.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point; no admission or watchdog override.
- No live vendor cloud without owner approval in the task.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (`make comment-policy-check`); user-facing changes add a `changelog.d/` fragment.
- Anchors (file:line, run ids) are orientation from 2026-11-19; re-read before editing and stop to update the item on a mismatch.
- Do not change the ClickHouse cells.
